title: Decentralized Equilibrium for Bitcoin Mining
abstract: arXiv:2604.06092v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin are defined by protocols that specify how participants record transactions and create new currency units. These protocols are not enforced by law or any central entity and instead are intended to be incentive compatible. However, the Bitcoin mining protocol proposed by Nakamoto (2008) and implemented in practice is known not to constitute an equilibrium (Eyal and Sirer, 2018). This leaves open the question of whether the decentralized outcome intended by Nakamoto can be sustained in equilibrium in the Bitcoin mining game. We propose inertial mining, a novel mining protocol that induces that outcome, i.e., a single longest chain in which each miner's asymptotic share of blocks equals its share of computational power. translated_title: 比特币挖矿的去中心化均衡
translated_abstract: 像比特币这样的加密货币由协议定义，这些协议规定了参与者如何记录交易和创造新货币单位。这些协议并非由法律或任何中心实体强制执行，而是旨在实现激励兼容。然而，由中本聪（2008）提出并在实践中实施的比特币挖矿协议已知并不构成均衡（Eyal 和 Sirer，2018）。这留下了一个悬而未决的问题：中本聪所设想的去中心化结果能否在比特币挖矿博弈中作为均衡得以维持。我们提出了惯性挖矿，一种新颖的挖矿协议，它诱导出该结果，即一条单一最长链，其中每个矿工的区块渐近份额等于其计算能力份额。我们的主要结果表明，假设没有矿工控制计算能力的一半或以上，惯性挖矿构成一个均衡。惯性挖矿与标准比特币挖矿在同步性假设下一致，但在异步设置中，它阻止了自私挖矿攻击。
tldr: 我们提出了一种名为“惯性挖矿”的新协议，它能确保比特币挖矿博弈中的去中心化均衡，防止自私挖矿，并保证每个矿工的区块份额与其算力份额相匹配。
en_tdlr: We propose a novel protocol called "inertial mining" that ensures a decentralized equilibrium in the Bitcoin mining game, preventing selfish mining and guaranteeing each miner's block share matches their computational power share.
